title: Ladakh hill council polls on Dec 4, protests erupt over winter timing

ai.summary: Political groups in Leh threatened an agitation after Ladakh announced December 4 elections for eight autonomous hill development councils, rejecting demands to avoid winter polling.

facts.claim: Ladakh announced Dec 4 elections to its eight autonomous hill development councils
facts.quote: Ladakh announced Dec 4 elections to its eight autonomous hill development councils

facts.claim: Political groups in Leh threatened an agitation
facts.quote: political groups in Leh threatened an agitation

facts.claim: rejecting demands to avoid holding the polls during the harsh winter months
facts.quote: rejecting demands to avoid holding the polls during the harsh winter months

ai.background_note: Ladakh, a union territory without a legislature since 2019, wants the same protections as tribal areas in four northeastern states under the Sixth Schedule.
